$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
ONE ROW, and it is the version this tree declares. 0.1.0a7 publishes the
module's own database structure — seven mod_deploy platform tables and 95
columns — and raises the declared dotmac-kernel floor from >=0.1.0a98 to
>=0.1.0a100, which is the version that first shipped the
`dotmac_kernel.product_database_catalog` module `database_catalog.py`
imports.
The row is added HERE and not in docs/published-versions.json, and the
ordering is load-bearing rather than tidy: the release floor is derived as
the maximum of the versions recorded there, so a row written before the
upload would raise the floor above the version being published and the
guard would refuse the release it exists to admit. The two files are never
both true about one version at once, and
test_the_ledger_and_the_published_record_never_claim_the_same_version
states that over the two FILES so it holds even in a tagless checkout.
declared_kernel_floor is carried on the row rather than only on the release
record, so the coupling a6 introduced — the recorded floor is CHECKED
against the declaration rather than transcribed beside it — holds from the
moment the version is declared instead of starting at publication. a6's own
row could not carry it: the field did not exist until the change that
raised the floor to a98.
The a4 row that used to sit here said `never-published` and outlived its
own publication by six hours. That is the stale absolution the
two-directional ratchet in test_ported_gate_declared_publication.py exists
to catch, and it did not catch it: CI checked out without tags, so the gate
could not see the tag that contradicted this file. Both halves are fixed
together — the row is gone and the checkout now fetches tags. a5's and a6's
rows were each deleted in the change that recorded their coordinates, which
is the discipline the a4 row failed, and a7's row is owed the same
treatment.

0.1.0a7.reason: Declared by this tree and not yet uploaded. a7 adds the source-owned ModuleDatabaseCatalogContributionV1 that publishes this module's exact mod_deploy structure — seven platform tables, 95 columns, with PostgreSQL type identity and modifiers, physical ordinals, nullability, server defaults and relation kinds, authored from the frozen migration lineage. That contract is `dotmac_kernel.product_database_catalog`, absent from the published dotmac_kernel-0.1.0a99 wheel and present in dotmac_kernel-0.1.0a100, so the declared kernel floor moves from >=0.1.0a98 to >=0.1.0a100 and the module the mutation lane greps for moves with it. Not a metadata repair: a6's artifact identity, behaviour and declaration all stand and a6 remains pinnable until a7 is published and verified. DELETE THIS ROW in the change that records a7's coordinates in docs/published-versions.json, and never later.
